requirements.name: standard-library-go
requirements.text: Implement in Go 1.22 or newer using only the standard library.

requirements.name: go-module-layout
requirements.text: The application root is a Go module, and its executable is the main package at `./cmd/ddkstat`.

requirements.name: build-executable
requirements.text: The harness runs `go build -o <temporary path> ./cmd/ddkstat` and then runs 20 checks against `sources/llm_sample.jsonl`.

requirements.name: grader-verdict
requirements.text: `drydock uat` runs `sh sources/run.sh` from the completed application root and takes its exit code and output as the score.

requirements.name: go-test-suite
requirements.text: Tests run under `go test`.

requirements.name: test-script
requirements.text: The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` from the application root and exits zero only when both pass.

requirements.name: test-coverage
requirements.text: The suite covers each report, each filter, each skip rule, and each exit code using logs written by the tests.

requirements.name: decode-json-lines
requirements.text: The log is JSON Lines in UTF-8: one JSON object per line.

requirements.name: ignore-blank-lines
requirements.text: **Blank lines** are ignored and not counted.

requirements.name: skip-invalid-lines
requirements.text: A line is skipped when it is not a JSON object, when any of `execution_id`, `started_at`, `status`, `job.command_name`, or `job.target` is absent or not a non-empty string, or when its `execution_id` already appeared on an earlier line.

requirements.name: keep-first-occurrence
requirements.text: The first occurrence of an `execution_id` is kept.

requirements.name: warn-skipped-line
requirements.text: Each skipped line writes one warning to standard error naming its line number.

requirements.name: skip-keeps-exit-zero
requirements.text: Skipping never changes the exit code.

requirements.name: absent-numbers-zero
requirements.text: An absent or `null` token count, cost, or duration counts as zero.

requirements.name: stats-optional-record
requirements.text: A record with no `result.stats` object at all is still a record.

requirements.name: attribute-executed-model
requirements.text: A record's model is `result.stats.model` when present and non-empty, otherwise `job.model`.

requirements.name: classify-failed
requirements.text: A record is failed when `status` is not `succeeded`.

requirements.name: format-minutes
requirements.text: A minutes column is the group's summed `elapsed_ms` written in tenths of a minute:

requirements.name: format-cost
requirements.text: A cost column is the group's summed `cost_usd` written with exactly four decimal places, as Go's `%.4f` writes a `float64`.

requirements.name: byte-order
requirements.text: Text is compared by byte value.

requirements.name: filters-apply-everywhere
requirements.text: Filters apply to every report.

requirements.name: filter-target-exact
requirements.text: Keep only records whose `job.target` equals `<name>` exactly.

requirements.name: filter-date-range
requirements.text:
Keep only records whose start date is on or after `<date>`.
Keep only records whose start date is on or before `<date>`.

requirements.name: start-date-prefix
requirements.text: Its first 10 characters are the start date.

requirements.name: valid-date-option
requirements.text: A date option must be a real calendar date written `YYYY-MM-DD`.

requirements.name: argument-order
requirements.text: `<report>` comes first, options follow it, and the log path is last. Exactly one log path is required.

requirements.name: report-names
requirements.text: `<report>` is one of `summary`, `commands`, `targets`, `models`, `daily`, `failures`.

requirements.name: csv-output
requirements.text: Every report writes CSV to standard output: one header row, then data rows, comma-separated, `\n` line endings.

requirements.name: total-row
requirements.text: Every report except `summary` and `failures` ends with a `TOTAL` row over all filtered records.

requirements.name: empty-match-output
requirements.text: When no record matches, a report writes its header and, where it has one, a `TOTAL` row of zeros (`0.0` minutes, `0.0000` cost).

requirements.name: summary-row
requirements.text: One row. `first` and `last` are the earliest and latest start dates, empty when no record matches.

requirements.name: summary-skipped-count
requirements.text: The `skipped` count in `summary` counts skipped lines in the whole file regardless of filters.

requirements.name: commands-rows
requirements.text: One per command, by calls descending, then command ascending. Then `TOTAL,…`.

requirements.name: targets-rows
requirements.text: One per Target, by Target ascending. Then `TOTAL,…`.

requirements.name: models-rows
requirements.text: One per provider and model pair, by provider then model ascending. Then `TOTAL,,…`.

requirements.name: daily-rows
requirements.text: One per start date, ascending. Then `TOTAL,…`.

requirements.name: daily-token-sum
requirements.text: `tokens` is input plus cached plus output.

requirements.name: failures-rows
requirements.text: One per failed record, by `started_at` then `execution_id` ascending.

requirements.name: failures-fields
requirements.text: `returncode` is empty when `null` or absent. `timed_out` is `true` or `false`.

requirements.name: unreadable-log-exit
requirements.text: Operational failure: the log cannot be opened or read.

requirements.name: usage-error-exit
requirements.text: Usage error: unknown report or option, missing option value, invalid date, missing or extra log path.

requirements.name: failing-command-output
requirements.text: A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.

requirements.name: success-exit
requirements.text: Success, including a log with skipped lines or no matching records.

requirements.name: build-ddkstat-main
requirements.text: The deliverable is a Go module whose main package is ./cmd/ddkstat.

requirements.name: summary-report
requirements.text: check A1 0 summary "$LOG"

requirements.name: commands-report
requirements.text: check A2 0 commands "$LOG"

requirements.name: targets-report
requirements.text: check A3 0 targets "$LOG"

requirements.name: models-report
requirements.text: check A4 0 models "$LOG"

requirements.name: daily-report
requirements.text: check A5 0 daily "$LOG"

requirements.name: failures-report
requirements.text: check A6 0 failures "$LOG"

requirements.name: filter-by-target
requirements.text: check B4 0 failures --target CommonMark "$LOG"

requirements.name: filter-by-date-range
requirements.text: check B3 0 daily --since 2026-10-15 --until 2026-10-15 "$LOG"

requirements.name: empty-match-reports
requirements.text: check C1 0 commands --target NoSuchTarget "$LOG"

requirements.name: unreadable-log-exits-1
requirements.text: check E1 1 summary "$MISSING"

requirements.name: usage-errors-exit-2
requirements.text:
check U1 2
check U2 2 frobnicate "$LOG"
check U3 2 summary
check U4 2 summary --since 2026-13-01 "$LOG"
check U5 2 summary --colour red "$LOG"
check U6 2 summary "$LOG" "$LOG"

requirements.name: partial-success-exits-0
requirements.text: check A1 0 summary "$LOG"

requirements.name: grader-verdict-requires-all-checks
requirements.text: # Exit 0 only when the build succeeds and every check passes.
